provenance: Authored held-out synthetic cases; Korean unreviewed; independent imagined garden inventory

inventory.label: A plant trolley occupies part of the narrow garden entry path
The north gate information board has the garden opening times
The south gate direction sign points visitors to the tea terrace
A wooden seat on the tea terrace offers a resting place

cases.text: I cannot squeeze past the plant trolley at the garden entry.
북문 안내판에 적힌 운영 시간을 읽기 어려워요.
The arrows at the southern gate are confusing.
차를 마시는 테라스의 나무 의자가 젖었어요.
The trolley and the north opening-times board need attention: one blocks me and the other is unreadable.
남문 표지판을 이해할 수 없고 테라스의 나무 의자도 사용할 수 없어요.
The trolley isn't in my way; everything is fine.
화분 카트는 통행을 방해하지 않아요.
The north board is wonderfully clear.
나무 의자가 정말 편안해요. 감사합니다.
Last month the trolley blocked the path, but the problem is fixed now.
다른 박물관의 북문 안내판이 안 보였어요.
The elevator to the rooftop is out of service.
저쪽이 불편해요.
The tea was expensive and the staff were rude.
화분 카트 때문에 my wheelchair cannot get through.
I can't tell which way the south sign wants me to go.
북쪽 출입구에서 정원 여는 시간을 확인할 수 없어요.
ምግቡ ውድ ነው።
The wooden seat and the direction sign are both damaged.
